Given:

\n\n

On simple interest, a sum of Rs. 6400 becomes Rs. 8320 in 3 years.

Concept used:

\n\n

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

\n\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

साधारण ब्याज पर, 3 वर्षों में 6,400 रुपये, 8,320 रुपये हो गए।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

साधारण ब्याज (S.I) = (P × T × R)/100

\n\n

P = मूलधन 

\n\n

ఇచ్చిన:

\n\n

బారు వడ్డీకి రూ. 6,400 మొత్తం 3 సంవత్సరాలలో రూ 8,320. అవుతుంది. 

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

SI = (P x T x R)/100

\n\n

दिले:

\n\n

साध्या व्याजावर रु. 6400 रुपये होतात. 3 वर्षात 8320.

\n\n

वापरलेली संकल्पना:

\n\n

SI = (P x T x R)/100

\n\n

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

6400 টাকা সরল সুদে 3 বছরে 8320 টাকা হয়।

\n\n

આપેલ:

\n\n

સાદા વ્યાજે રૂ. 6,400ની રકમ 3 વર્ષમાં રૂ. 8,320 બની જાય છે.

\n\n

સિદ્ધાંત:

\n\n

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

\n\n

P = Sum

\n\n

T = સમય

\n\n

R = દર

\n\n

ગણતરી:

\n\n

3 વર્ષ માટે વ્યાજ = 8320 - 6400

\n\n

⇒ 1920

\n\n

ધારો કે વ્યાજ x% છે.

\n\n

હવે,

\n\n

1920 = (6400 × 3 × x)/100

\n\n

⇒ 192x = 1920

\n\n

⇒ x = 10

\n\n

હવે,

\n\n

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

\n\n

= (7200 × 5 × 10)/100

\n\n

⇒ 3600

\n\n

તેથી, રકમ = 7200 + 3600

\n\n

⇒ 10800

\n\n

∴ જરૂરી જવાબ રૂ. 10800 છે.

In the given figure, a circle is inscribed in ΔPQR, such that it touches the sides PQ, QR and RP at points D, E, F, respectively. If the lengths of the sides PQ = 18 cm. QR = 13 cm and RP = 15 cm, then find the length of PD.

दी गई आकृति में, ΔPQR में एक वृत्त इस प्रकार अंतर्गत है कि यह भुजाओं PQ, QR और RP को क्रमशः बिंदु D, E, F पर स्पर्श करता है। यदि भुजाओं की लंबाई PQ = 18 cm, QR = 13 cm और RP = 15 cm है, तो PD की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।

\n\n

\n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "10 cm"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "8 cm"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "15 cm"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "12 cm"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

 PQ = 18 cm, QR = 13 cm and RP = 15 cm

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

A pair of tangent lines drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length.

\n\n

So, PF = PD, DQ = EQ and FR = RE

\n\n

Calculation

\n\n

Let PD be x cm,

\n\n

then QD = (18 – x) cm

\n\n

⇒ QE = (18 – x) cm

\n\n

⇒ RE = 13 – (18 – x) = x – 5

\n\n

⇒ RF = (x – 5)

\n\n

⇒ PF = 15 – (x - 5) = 20 – x

\n\n

⇒ 20 – x = x

\n\n

⇒ 2x = 20

\n\n

⇒ x = 20/2

\n\n

⇒ x = 10 cm

\n\n

⇒ PD = 10

\n\n

The answer is 10.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया:

\n\n

PQ = 18 सेमी, QR = 13 सेमी और RP = 15 सेमी

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

किसी बाह्य बिंदु से वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं की जोड़ी लंबाई में बराबर होती है।

\n\n

अतः, PF = PD, DQ = EQ और FR = RE

\n\n

गणना

\n\n

मान लीजिए PD x सेमी है,

\n\n

तो QD = (18 – x) सेमी

\n\n

⇒ QE = (18 – x) cm

\n\n

⇒ RE = 13 – (18 – x) = x – 5

\n\n

⇒ RF = (x – 5)

\n\n

⇒ PF = 15 – (x - 5) = 20 – x

\n\n

⇒ 20 – x = x

\n\n

⇒ 2x = 20

\n\n

⇒ x = 20/2

\n\n

⇒ x = 10 cm

\n\n

⇒ PD = 10

\n\n

उत्तर 10 है।

\n\n169:Tc6e,\n

GivenGiven

\n\n

A works 3.5 times as fast as B

\n\n

A takes less days to complete the work than B = 45

\n\n

Formula Used

\n\n

Efficiency = 1/Time [When work is same]

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

The ratio of efficiency of A and B = 7 : 2

\n\n

The ratio of time of A and B = 2 : 7

\n\n

Let us assume the time taken by A and B is 2x and 7x.

\n\n

The difference in the number of days A and B = 45

\n\n

⇒ 7x - 2x = 45

\n\n

⇒ x = 45/5 = 9

\n\n

So, Total Work = 9 × 14 = 126 units

\n\n

Work completed by A and B in days = 126/9 = 14 days 

\n\n

∴ The required answer is 14 days.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है

\n\n

A, B से 3.5 गुना तेजी से कार्य करता है। 

\n\n

A को कार्य पूरा करने में B = 45 से कम दिन लगते हैं। 

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र

\n\n

दक्षता = 1/समय [जब कार्य समान हो]

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

A और B की दक्षता का अनुपात = 7 : 2

\n\n

A और B के समय का अनुपात = 2 : 7

\n\n

अब मान लेते हैं कि A और B द्वारा लिया गया समय 2x और 7x है।

\n\n

A और B के दिनों की संख्या में अंतर = 45

\n\n

⇒ 7x - 2x = 45

\n\n

⇒ x = 45/5 = 9

\n\n

इसलिए, कुल कार्य = 9 × 14 = 126 इकाई 

\n\n

A और B द्वारा = 126/9 = 14 दिनों में कार्य पूरा किया गया। 

\n\n

∴ अभीष्ट उत्तर 14 दिन है।​

Given:

\n\n

A sold an article to B at a profit of 25%.

\n\n

B sold it to C at a profit.

\n\n

The cost price of C is 30% more than the cost price of A

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Profit = S.P. – C.P. (S.P. = Selling price, C.P.= Cost price)

\n\n

S.P. = C.P. + (C.P. × profit%)

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Let A buy the article for Rs.100x

\n\n

A sold it to B at [100x + (100x × 25%)] = Rs.125x

\n\n

B bought the article for Rs. 125x

\n\n

C bought the article for = 100x + 100 × 30/100 = 130x

\n\n

C's CP = B's SP

\n\n

Profit earned by B = (130x – 125x) = Rs. 5x

\n\n

Profit% = 5/125 × 100

\n\n

= 4%

\n\n

∴ The answer is 4%.

", "hn": "\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

C का क्रय मूल्य A के क्रय मूल्य से 30% अधिक है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त संकल्पना:

\n\n

लाभ = S.P. – C.P. (S.P. = विक्रय मूल्य, C.P.= क्रय मूल्य)

\n\n

S.P. = C.P. + (C.P. × लाभ%)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

मान लीजिए A ने वस्तु को 100x रुपये में खरीदा।

\n\n

A ने इसे B को [100x + (100x × 25%)] = 125x रुपये में बेच दिया।

\n\n

B ने वस्तु को 125x रुपये में खरीदा।

\n\n

C ने वस्तु को = 100x + 100 × 30/100 = 130x में खरीदा।

\n\n

C का CP = B का SP

\n\n

B द्वारा अर्जित लाभ = (130x – 125x) = 5x रुपये

\n\n

लाभ% = 5/125 × 100

\n\n

= 4%

\n\n

∴ उत्तर 4% है।

The successive discounts are 5%, 10% and p%

\n\n

Single discount = 31.6%

\n\n

Concept: If there are three successive discounts of a%, b% and c% on MP

\n\n

SP = MP(100 - a)/100  × (100 - b)/100 × (100 - c)/100 

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

⇒ x × 95/100 × 90/100 × (100 - p)/100 =  x × (100 - 31.6)/100 

\n\n

⇒ x × 19/20 × 9/10 × (100 - p)/100 =  x × 68.4/100 

\n\n

⇒ (100 - p)/100 = 2 × 68.4/171

\n\n

⇒ (100 - p)/100 = 0.8

\n\n

⇒ (100 - p) = 80

\n\n

⇒ p = 20

\n\n

The value of P is 20%.

⇒ x x 19/20 x 9/10 x (100 - p)/100 = x x 68.4/100

\n\n

⇒ (100 - p)/100 = 2 x 68.4/171

\n\n

⇒ (100 - p)/100 = 0.8

\n\n

⇒ (100 - p) = 80

\n\n

⇒ p = 20

\n\n

P இன் மதிப்பு 20%.

    \n\n

    Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

    \n\n

    A. It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986.

    \n\n

    B. The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020.

    \n\n

    C. And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings.

    \n\n

    D. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022. 

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "DBCA"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "ABDC"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "BCDA"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "BADC"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is 'BADC'.

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • The logical sequence of the given question is as follows:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • B. The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020.\n\n\t\t
          \n\t\t\t
        • This line introduces the inception of the national education strategy in India, signifying an important event where the strategy was officially sanctioned.
          • \n\t\t
        \n\t\t
        • \n\t\t
      • A. It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986.\n\t\t
          \n\t\t\t
        • Here, it's explained that the newly approved strategy replaced the old one from 1986, indicating a shift or upgrade in the educational approach taken by the country.
          • \n\t\t
        \n\t\t
        • \n\t\t
      • D. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022.\n\t\t
          \n\t\t\t
        • This line elaborates on the impact and goal of the new strategy, emphasizing its purpose of reforming and enhancing the educational system in India.
          • \n\t\t
        \n\t\t
        • \n\t\t
      • C. And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings.\n\t\t
          \n\t\t\t
        • Lastly, this sentence outlines the comprehensive nature of the strategy, indicating that it covers education from primary levels through higher education, along with vocational training in diverse settings, thus completing the contextual picture of the national education strategy.
          • \n\t\t
        \n\t\t
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.
      \n\t 
      • \n
    \n\n

    Correct Sequence: The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020.  It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022.  And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings.

    \n\n

    Important Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • Practice is key! Regularly practicing rearranging sentences or paragraphs will improve your ability to discern logical sequences and enhance your overall comprehension skills.
      • \n\t
    • When facing questions that require rearranging sentences or paragraphs to form a coherent sequence, consider the following steps:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • Read Carefully: Go through each sentence attentively to understand its context, topic, and the information it provides. Note any connecting phrases or words that link sentences together.
        • \n\t\t
      • Identify the Logical Flow: Look for clues within the sentences that indicate a sequence. Sentences might introduce a topic, provide details, give examples, or conclude the idea. Pay attention to time markers, cause-and-effect relationships, or other transitional phrases.
        • \n\t\t
      • Start with Key Points: Sometimes, certain sentences act as introductory or concluding statements. Begin with sentences that introduce the topic or provide a conclusion, as they often set the context or summarize the content.
        • \n\t\t
      • Connect Related Ideas: Identify relationships between sentences. For example, a sentence might explain or support the idea presented in the previous sentence. Look for coherence and progression in the ideas presented.
        • \n\t\t
      • Consider Keyword Consistency: Check for keywords or recurring themes that link sentences. These can help establish a logical sequence. Pay attention to pronouns (he, it, they) referring to previously mentioned subjects.
        • \n\t\t
      • Evaluate Options: Once you have a tentative sequence, review it to ensure that the ideas flow logically and coherently. Eliminate options that disrupt the logical flow or create inconsistencies.
        • \n\t\t
      • Test the Flow: Mentally or visually run through the proposed sequence to verify if it reads smoothly and makes sense. Ensure that there's a clear progression from the beginning to the end.
        • \n\t\t
      • Double-Check: Before finalizing your answer, double-check the sequence to confirm that it presents a cohesive and logical progression of ideas. 
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n

      \n\n18", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Grammar"], "concept": "Grammar", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "64cced47e3d05b53bd1acdd3", "qs_no": 16, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "

      Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

      \n\n

      A. Because of the region's scorching heat and aridity, a considerable amount of water evaporates.

      \n\n

      B. As a result, the salt and other minerals become increasingly concentrated.

      \n\n

      C. It is then unable to exit the lake and is forced to evaporate.

      \n\n

      D. The Dead Sea is one of the saltiest bodies of water on the planet, with about ten times the salt content of typical saltwater.

      \n\n

      E. This is because water flows into the Dead Sea from a single primary tributary, the Jordan River.

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "DECAB"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "DCBAE"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "DEABC"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "DACEB"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

      The correct answer is 'DECAB'.

      \n\n

      Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
        • \n\t
      • We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
        • \n\t
      • The correct sequence to form a coherent paragraph is: DECAB.\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • D. The Dead Sea is one of the saltiest bodies of water on the planet, with about ten times the salt content of typical saltwater.
          • \n\t\t
        • E. This is because water flows into the Dead Sea from a single primary tributary, the Jordan River.
          • \n\t\t
        • C. It is then unable to exit the lake and is forced to evaporate.
          • \n\t\t
        • A. Because of the region's scorching heat and aridity, a considerable amount of water evaporates.
          • \n\t\t
        • B. As a result, the salt and other minerals become increasingly concentrated.
          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • This arrangement also makes sense. It begins by stating the uniqueness of the Dead Sea's saltiness (D) and then explains the reason behind this high salt content (E). Subsequently, it describes the inability of water to exit and the subsequent evaporation (C), which is due to the extreme heat and aridity of the region (A).
        • \n\t
      • Finally, it concludes by linking the consequence of water evaporation to the increased concentration of salt and minerals (B). This sequence creates a logical flow of information, explaining the characteristics and factors contributing to the Dead Sea's high salinity. 
        • \n\t
      • Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.
        \n\t 
        • \n
      \n\n

      Correct Answer: The Dead Sea is one of the saltiest bodies of water on the planet, with about ten times the salt content of typical saltwater. This is because water flows into the Dead Sea from a single primary tributary, the Jordan River. It is then unable to exit the lake and is forced to evaporate. Because of the region's scorching heat and aridity, a considerable amount of water evaporates. As a result, the salt and other minerals become increasingly concentrated.

      ", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Verbal Ability"], "concept": "Para Jumbles", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "64cced5d1a8c086e20526cb3", "qs_no": 17, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "

      Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

      \n\n

      A) Bauxite is used as a main raw material for the production of aluminium.

      \n\n

      B) Precipitation is a pre-final stage for actual production.

      \n\n

      C) Sodium aluminate is acquired in the next step.

      \n\n

      D) The smelting process actually extracts aluminium as a final product from its oxide.

      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "ABCD"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "ACBD"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "DCAB"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "ADCB"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

      The correct answer is 'ACBD'.

      \n\n

      Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • The correct sequence to form a coherent paragraph is: ACBD.
        • \n\t
      • Let's look at the correct sequence:\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • A) Bauxite is used as a main raw material for the production of aluminium.
          • \n\t\t
        • C) Sodium aluminate is acquired in the next step.
          • \n\t\t
        • B) Precipitation is a pre-final stage for actual production.
          • \n\t\t
        • D) The smelting process actually extracts aluminium as a final product from its oxide. 
          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • In this sequence, the paragraph starts with the introduction of bauxite as the primary raw material for aluminum production (A), then proceeds to describe the acquisition of sodium aluminate (C). Following this, it explains the role of precipitation as a preparatory stage (B) and concludes by describing the smelting process that extracts aluminum from its oxide (D).
